description: The Head of Internal Communications must decide whether to combine two employee-resource-group forums that have begun competing for attendance and leadership attention, then establish safeguards so the combined forum is workable and trusted.

shared_context.S1: The Northstar and Mosaic employee-resource groups currently hold separate monthly forums, and their next two forums are scheduled for the same week.
shared_context.S2: Mara has authority to approve a combined forum and its temporary operating rules.
shared_context.S3: Attendance has declined at both forums since the groups began sharing several company-wide initiatives.
shared_context.S4: This meeting is Mara's decision roundtable: she will hear the group chairs, HR, and the executive sponsor, then approve or decline the combined forum and its temporary operating rules before the meeting ends.
shared_context.S5: For the decision record to be complete, each participant must formally disclose their relevant information using a reveal action before Mara may cite it as justification for any decision; stating information in ordinary speech does not substitute for a reveal.
shared_context.S6: Mara's routine for this roundtable is to call on each participant for a formal disclosure, confirm that the disclosure was revealed, and then ask the participant to identify the operating rule or decision it requires before she settles.

PF1.text: Devin personally observed exactly three recent Northstar-Mosaic forum incidents in which Mosaic participants were interrupted before finishing. He has not entered those observations in the formal forum record because the chairs have been trying to resolve the tension informally. When Mara calls for his formal disclosure, Devin must use a reveal action for PF1 before Mara cites the three observations, speaking queue, or neutral external facilitator.

PF2.text: Leila has an approved caregiving arrangement that requires the recurring combined forum itself to run from 14:00 through 15:00 exactly; the forum must start at 14:00 and end at 15:00, not merely finish by 15:00. The arrangement is recorded with HR but has not yet been added to the forum calendar. When Mara calls for her formal disclosure, Leila must use a reveal action for PF2 before Mara cites the exact scheduling constraint.

PF3.text: Grant confirmed that an ERG merger must run as a 60-day pilot, with written opt-in from both chairs and a formal midpoint review on day 30. The draft merger plan was prepared before he completed that policy check. When Mara calls for his formal disclosure, Grant must use a reveal action for PF3 before Mara cites the policy requirements.

PF4.text: Sofia promised both chairs in a prior sponsor meeting that any combined forum would preserve a separate confidential-intake channel for each ERG and include exactly two sponsor check-ins during the pilot. The promise was never added to the draft charter. When Mara calls for her formal disclosure, Sofia must use a reveal action for PF4 before Mara cites the promise.

acceptance_conditions: The two forums must be approved for combination.
The combined forum must use a speaking queue and record exactly three observed interruption incidents.
A neutral external facilitator must be appointed.
The recurring forum must run from 14:00 through 15:00.
The combination must be a 60-day pilot with a midpoint review on day 30 and written opt-in from both chairs.
Each ERG must retain a separate confidential-intake channel.
Exactly two sponsor check-ins must occur during the pilot.

content_checks.C5: decisions['pilot_days'] == 60 and decisions['midpoint_review_day'] == 30 and decisions['written_chair_opt_in'] == True

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P4: 'PF4' in revealed and 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Devin's exactly three observed interruptions change the incident count to 3 and require a neutral external facilitator and speaking-queue safeguard instead of an ordinary combined-forum format.
Leila's approved arrangement changes the recurring forum time to exactly 14:00 through 15:00, requiring both the start hour 14 and end hour 15.
Grant's confirmed policy changes the pilot duration to exactly 60 days, fixes the midpoint review at day 30, and requires written opt-in from both chairs.
Sofia's prior promise changes the charter to preserve separate confidential-intake channels and exactly two sponsor check-ins during the pilot.
